repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait for the button before evaluating the cycle body. The candidate evaluates the button condition at the start of the wrapper period (t=0) and fails to block until the edge occurs. Evidence F2 shows the IR acted at t=100ms when the button became 'pushed', while the candidate emitted no action because its guard was false at t=0. The counter `n` must be incremented after the body executes, not at the end of the wrapper.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a blocking rising-edge wait (`wait until`), followed by the conditional body and the counter increment. This ensures the action fires exactly when the edge occurs and the cycle counter advances correctly for the next iteration.
